goal: Author the Phase D failure taxonomy and evaluator-coverage map as a READ_ONLY / DESIGN_ONLY analytical report over already-existing Phase B/C evidence, and update only the minimum canonical checkpoint/state/changelog/test surfaces so fresh sessions can recover Phase D as COMPLETED_BY_OPERATOR / PENDING_BORA_ACCEPTANCE / READ_ONLY_DESIGN_ONLY with implementation_authorized remaining false and Phase E remaining PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED. This contract governs the substantive Phase D work itself; it does not perform, expand, or presuppose the content of that work. No product implementation, no evaluator code, no CAREER_OS_RUN_TRACE_V1 or trace infrastructure, no database/UI/automation, no new agent, no model routing, and no LLM judge is authorized by this contract.
acceptance_conditions: the taxonomy/evaluator-coverage-map report, when authored, labels every material claim OBSERVED, RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_DURABLE_EVIDENCE, EXPERIMENTAL_NON_CANONICAL, or MISSING, and does not upgrade any UNKNOWN or MISSING evidence state

any reference to the Antigravity benchmark #1 is labeled EXPERIMENTAL_NON_CANONICAL only and is never treated as authoritative or as granting any authority over taxonomy, severity, or evaluator design

the report may mention CAREER_OS_RUN_TRACE_V1 only as an explicitly out-of-scope/future architecture item or a known missing observability surface, and must not design, specify, schema, implement, or authorize CAREER_OS_RUN_TRACE_V1, any trace schema or trace infrastructure, evaluator code, a model router, an LLM judge, a database/UI surface, orchestration automation, or a new runtime agent

any change to AGENTS.md or docs/decisions/ADR-CAREER-OS-EVAL-HARNESS-SEQUENCE-V1.md is limited strictly to live status/recovery pointer synchronization for Phase D completion; no locked role, roadmap sequence, policy principle, or substantive doctrine change to either file is authorized
the report does not claim or imply fallback-builder authority over any locked rule, and does not perform an experimental-run-receipts audit
the report does not perform or propose a context-surface refactor (CLAUDE.md/.cursor/.claude structural change) under Phase D
the report does not authorize, imply authorization of, or perform any Phase E or later roadmap phase work

CURRENT_EXECUTION_CHECKPOINT.json, project_state.json, CURRENT_STATE.md, and CURRENT_MILESTONE.md are updated only to record Phase D as COMPLETED_BY_OPERATOR / PENDING_BORA_ACCEPTANCE / READ_ONLY_DESIGN_ONLY, with implementation_authorized remaining false and Phase E remaining PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED
CHANGELOG.md records the Phase D substantive-work completion as a distinct dated entry
no existing locked rule, policy principle, or substantive roadmap doctrine (BLUEPRINT.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or any prior-accepted ADR) is changed
the dedicated regression test and the execution-checkpoint test fail closed on any violation of this contract
